---
title: "Tree Based Methods"
---


## Readings

*An Introduction to Statistical Learning* chapter 8.1.

*Hands-on Machine Learning with R* has a nice chapter on [tree based methods](https://bradleyboehmke.github.io/HOML/DT.html).


## Assignments

Download the Rmarkdown file and open it in RStudio. The first part will walk through and explain implementing the key concepts for this week. Complete the questions in the *on your own* section at the end. Submit your PDF to Brightspace.

* Tree Based Methods Lab ([PDF](/assignments/decision_trees/decision_trees.pdf), [Rmarkdown](/assignments/decision_trees/decision_trees.Rmd))
